def prefix_storage_ledger(files, reported, actual, parent, role):
    """Verify every report storage binding against the actual logical-byte closure.

    Paths may be relocated to an independent checkout; exact basenames,
    byte counts, multiplicities and SHA256s remain part of the identity.
    """
    check(type(reported) is list and type(actual) is list and len(reported) == len(actual),
          'Incomplete prefix storage ledger: '+role)
    def key(item):
        check(type(item) is dict and set(item) == {'file', 'bytes', 'sha256'} and
              type(item['file']) is str and type(item['bytes']) is int and
              0 < item['bytes'] < 5_000_000, 'Invalid storage item: '+role)
        path = files.file(item['file'], item['sha256'], parent, role)
        check(path.stat().st_size == item['bytes'], 'Changed storage item size: '+role)
        return (Path(item['file']).name, item['bytes'], item['sha256'])
    expected = sorted(key(item) for item in actual)
    received = sorted(key(item) for item in reported)
    check(len(set(expected)) == len(expected) and received == expected,
          'Different prefix storage closure: '+role)

def prefix_storage_ledger(files, reported, actual, parent, role):
    """Match relocatable report identities to the descriptor's actual file closure.

    A report's old absolute paths need not still exist. Exact basenames,
    byte counts, multiplicities and SHA256s must first match the independently
    resolved base/descriptor closure. Only those actual paths are then read.
    """
    check(type(reported) is list and type(actual) is list and len(reported) == len(actual),
          'Incomplete prefix storage ledger: '+role)
    def key(item):
        check(type(item) is dict and set(item) == {'file', 'bytes', 'sha256'} and
              type(item['file']) is str and type(item['bytes']) is int and
              0 < item['bytes'] < 5_000_000 and type(item['sha256']) is str and
              len(item['sha256']) == 64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in item['sha256']),
              'Invalid storage item: '+role)
        return (Path(item['file']).name, item['bytes'], item['sha256'])
    expected = sorted(key(item) for item in actual)
    received = sorted(key(item) for item in reported)
    check(len(set(expected)) == len(expected) and received == expected,
          'Different prefix storage closure: '+role)
    for item in actual:
        path = files.file(item['file'], item['sha256'], parent, role)
        check(path.stat().st_size == item['bytes'], 'Changed storage item size: '+role)
